source_refs.note: 2- Sex-influenced Traits: a main subheading of 18.8.3 Sex-limited and Sex-influenced Traits, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 111-111.

blocks.text: In some traits, the same gene shows different expression in each sex. Sex-influenced genes have alleles which are dominant in one sex and recessive in the other. This difference in expression is due to hormonal difference between the males and females. For example, in humans, the traits of the amounts of body hair and baldness are sex-influenced traits. The allele of baldness is dominant in men but recessive in women. So, a man can be bald when he is homozygous (BB) or heterozygous (Bb) for baldness alleles. While a woman can be bald only when she inherits two recessive alleles (bb).

blocks.title: Book correction
blocks.text: With B written for the baldness allele, as in the sentence before, a woman is bald only when she inherits two baldness alleles, that is BB; the book prints bb, which is the genotype with no baldness allele.

blocks.title: For Information
blocks.text:
Genetics has made significant progress. Now, it is more applied and practical science. For example:
• DNA sequencing and genetic engineering, have enabled researchers to manipulate genes.
• The completion of Human Genome Project has led to a deeper understanding of the genetic basis of various diseases and traits.
• Genetics plays important role in healthcare, helping doctors to diagnose and treat patients based on their unique genetic profiles.
